units.source_text: "总之，在这里花钱就是我的义务。"

en.t: In any case, spending money here is my duty.

units.source_text: 我继续寻思，"总之，在这里把学费花光才好呢。

en.t: I kept thinking, "In any case, it would be best to spend all my tuition money here.

units.source_text: 这样一来，就给老师以将我驱逐出寺庙的最好的借口。"

en.t: That way, I would give the teacher the best possible excuse to drive me out of the temple."
